extras.name: Infinite Repel
extras.what: Keeps wild Pokémon away until you switch it off in the skills menu.
extras.takes: Beat Lass Anne in Viridian Forest

extras.name: Running Shoes
extras.what: Run with B.
extras.takes: Oak's Aide catches up with you

extras.name: Egg seller
extras.what: Sells one egg: a Wonder Egg (a random first-form Pokémon, even Cosmog) or a Paldean Egg (a Paldean Pokémon).

extras.name: Egg seller
extras.what: Sells one egg: a Wonder Egg (a random first-form Pokémon, even Cosmog) or a Paldean Egg (a Paldean Pokémon).

extras.name: Lucario fan
extras.what: Come back with a Lucario following you and answer the questions about Lucario sets for the Lucarionite.
extras.takes: A Lucario following you, after your fifth badge

extras.name: Cheat codes
extras.what: Woyaopp: Rare Candy cheat (the youngster in Viridian City sells them; the Pokémon Center helper sets a Pokémon to the level cap). DexAll: DexNav cheat. SO2Toxic: care packages. TeamPreview: see the opponent's team before a battle. EZCatch: easy catching.
extras.takes: Type the code at the sign

extras.name: Time Changer
extras.what: Sets the time of day (day, night or dusk) from the skills menu: night encounters and night or day evolutions on demand.
extras.takes: Answer three questions: Pancham (no night evolution), 5 PM (night encounters start), Never

extras.name: PokéVial trial
extras.what: Win his puzzle battle for the PokéVial: a portable Pokémon Center in the skills menu, 6 heals, refilled by Nurse Joy.

extras.name: Pokémon follower
extras.what: Lets one of your Pokémon out of its ball to walk behind you; talk again to put it back. Four people want to see a certain Pokémon following you: a Lucario (Celadon City), a Yamper (Vermilion City), a Sharpedo (Route 12) and a Swampert (Saffron City).

extras.name: Egg seller
extras.what: Sells one egg: a Wonder Egg (a random first-form Pokémon, even Cosmog) or a Paldean Egg (a Paldean Pokémon).

extras.name: Move Maniac (Move Relearner)
extras.what: Win his puzzle battle and the Move Relearner is unlocked in your party menu for good; he also teaches the moves himself.
extras.takes: Win the puzzle battle (or two Tiny Mushrooms or a Big Mushroom per move before that)

extras.name: EV trainer
extras.what: A battle against a family of Audinos for Exp. ($10,000), or EV training ($2,000).

extras.name: Yamper lover
extras.what: Come back with a Yamper following you and the two Yampers play: 5 Wish Pieces.

extras.name: Metronome gambler
extras.what: Bet $10,000, $50,000 or $100,000 on a battle of six Lv 100 Metronome-only Pokémon on each side; a win pays double.
extras.takes: Money to bet; pure luck (save first)

extras.name: Move Deleter
extras.what: Makes a Pokémon forget a move (even an HM).

extras.name: Egg Move tutor
extras.what: Teaches Egg moves without breeding.
extras.takes: Name four Pokémon from their cries

extras.name: Wild double battles
extras.what: Turns wild double battles on or off.

extras.name: Mudkip fan
extras.what: Answer no twice and the kid battles you (a Swampert team, cap 68) for TM26 (Earthquake). Come back with a Swampert following you for the Swampertite, then with the Z-Power Ring for a second battle (Gian, cap 85) and a Lv 50 Cosmog.
extras.takes: Answer no twice; then a Swampert following you; then the Z-Power Ring

extras.name: EV reducer
extras.what: Takes EVs off a stat or resets them all.

extras.name: Ability swapper
extras.what: Swaps a Pokémon between its hidden ability and a normal one.

extras.name: EV checker
extras.what: Shows a Pokémon's EVs.

extras.name: IV setter
extras.what: Sets one IV to 0 (minimum Speed for Trick Room).

extras.name: IV checker
extras.what: Shows a Pokémon's IVs.

extras.name: Ball switcher
extras.what: Moves a Pokémon to another kind of Poké Ball.

extras.name: Hidden Power IVs
extras.what: Sets the IVs for the Hidden Power type you want (every IV must be 30 or more).

extras.name: Day Care man (Eevee)
extras.what: Beat him with the six Hisuian Pokémon he lends you (Lv 100 on both sides) for a Lv 5 Eevee.
extras.takes: Win the rental battle (try as often as you like)

extras.name: Stone finder
extras.what: Show a Sharpedo following you and the stone reacts: the Sharpedonite.

extras.name: Battle Simulator
extras.what: Battles against random boss trainers of the region, with prizes.

extras.name: Starter tutor
extras.what: Teaches starter-only moves once you beat him in a starter-only battle.
extras.takes: Win a battle using only starter Pokémon

extras.name: Pokémon Center helper
extras.what: Changes a Pokémon's nature for free; swaps the gender of Snorunt, Ralts, Kirlia, Salandit, Burmy, Combee, Espurr, Basculin and Lechonk (their evolutions need one); tells you the mode you play; redeems codes (Mystery Gift); and, with the Rare Candy code on, sets a Pokémon to the level cap.
